# BINDING CONSISTENCY LEDGER — Lithuanian Listening Pod (15 scenes)

## 1. TRANSLITERATION
Not needed — names stay as written. Lithuanian uses Latin script with diacritics (ą, č, ę, ė, į, š, ų, ū, ž).

## 2. PRICES
- £8.40 → aštuoni eurai keturiasdešimt centų
- £12.50 → dvylika eurų penkiasdešimt centų

## 3. TARGET-LANGUAGE NAME
Lithuanian = *lietuvių* (or *lietuvių kalbą* / *lietuviškai* in context: "I'm learning Lithuanian" → "Mokausi lietuvių kalbos")

## 4. RECURRING LINES
- "Good morning" → *Labas rytas*
- "Good afternoon" → *Laba diena*
- "Good evening" → *Labas vakaras*
- "What can I get you?" → *Ką tau / jums padaryti?* [see REGISTER]
- "See you later" / "See you then" → *Iki pasimatymo*
- "Thank you very much" → *Ačiū, daug ačiū*
- "Goodbye" → *Viso gero*
- "Pleased to meet you" → *Malonu susipažinti*
- "You're welcome" → *Prašom*
- "Excuse me" → *Atsiprašau* or *Gal tu / jūs galėtumei...* [varies by scene context]
- "Could I pay by card?" → *Ar galiu mokėti kortele?*
- "Do you have contactless?" → *Ar yra bezkontaktis?*

## 5. REGISTER

| Relationship | Unmarked Level | Example Scenes |
|---|---|---|
| **Customer ↔ Service staff** (barista, bartender, waiter, shop, pharmacy, taxi, hotel) | *Jūs* (formal) | Scenes 3, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14 |
| **Strangers, brief interactions** (passenger, tourist, local giving directions) | *Tu* (informal peer default) | Scenes 2, 6, 13 |
| **Neighbour** | *Tu* (peer, familiar) | Scenes 1, 5 |
| **Friend** | *Tu* (close peer) | Scenes 4, 15 |
| **Service staff to customer (opening)** | *Jūs* initially; may mirror customer's register | All service scenes |

**Default:** Staff use *jūs* with all customers unless customer initiates *tu*. Peers always *tu*.
